blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier text-to-image (T2I) foundation models predominantly rely on multi-billion parameter Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pretrained across massive compute clusters, creating an accessibility barrier for academic laboratories. When training DiTs from scratch on single consumer GPUs (e.g., an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24\,GB VRAM), practitioners encounter three primary bottlenecks: quadratic attention sequence costs, Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation graph breaks induced by variable aspect-ratio bucketing, and an autoencoder throughput wall where frozen Variational Autoencoder (VAE) operations dominate step latency. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Asuka-FM}, an end-to-end system and architectural framework demonstrating that competitive dual-stream DiTs ($\sim$206M parameters) can be pretrained from scratch on a single consumer GPU in $\sim$160 GPU hours for under \$55. Asuka-FM integrates four core designs: (i) an AdaLN-free dual-stream DiT backbone reducing parameter count; (ii) structured sequence sparsification via Sparse-Dense Residual Fusion (SPRINT) to cut attention FLOPs by over 50\%; (iii) continuous aspect-normalized Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) coupled with shifted square crop training, guaranteeing static tensor shapes while unlocking zero-shot virtual camera control; and (iv) a pixel adaptation phase utilizing a lightweight (10M parameter) Patch Detailer Head operating under velocity regression ($v$-prediction). Evaluated on open-domain benchmarks without benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Asuka-FM achieves GenEval 0.588 / DPG 78.96 scores at 256px and GenEval 0.609 / DPG 78.51 scores at 512px, setting a new Pareto-optimal efficiency standard for democratic foundation modeling.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The emergence of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 34 ] trained via flow matching [ 27 ] has established a new state of the art in high-fidelity text-to-image (T2I) synthesis. However, state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX.1 (12B) [ 3 ] , SD3 (8B) [ 16 ] , and Qwen-Image (20B) [ 45 ] , have scaled parameter counts and training datasets to regimes that require industrial-scale data centers. This trajectory has widened the accessibility gap, preventing independent researchers and academic groups with limited resources from training generative models from scratch.
blocks.zh: 通过流量匹配[27]培训的传播变形器(DiTs)[34]的出现,在高纯度文本对图像(T2I)合成中建立了一种新的艺术状态. 然而,先进的模型,如FLUX.1(12B)[3],SD3(8B)[16],以及Quen-Image(20B)[45],已经将参数计数和培训数据集缩放到需要工业规模数据中心的制度. 这一轨迹扩大了无障碍差距,使资源有限的独立研究人员和学术团体无法从头开始培训基因模型。

blocks.en: When attempting to pretrain generative diffusion models under compute-constrained environments (e.g., a single workstation with an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24 GB GDDR6X), the standard pretraining paradigm encounters three fundamental systems bottlenecks: • (i) Quadratic Attention Sequence Redundancy: Standard homogeneous DiTs allocate identical full-token sequence lengths across every transformer block. However, recent representational analyses [ 33 ] reveal that early layers primarily capture local high-frequency textures, whereas deep middle blocks model global macro-semantics. Processing full-length sequences across deep layers wastes limited floating-point operations (FLOPs) on redundant spatial details, slowing convergence. • (ii) Just-In-Time (JIT) Compilation Graph Breaks vs. Aspect-Ratio Bucketing: Real-world images feature diverse aspect ratios. Conventional pipelines handle this via dynamic aspect-ratio bucketing, grouping images of varying shapes into specialized mini-batches. Under modern tracing and JIT compiler runtimes (e.g., torch.compile with TorchInductor), changing spatial dimensions dynamically triggers continuous kernel recompilations, invalidates static CUDA graphs, and severely degrades actual Model FLOPs Utilization ( MFU act \text{MFU}_{\text{act}} ). • (iii) The Autoencoder Throughput Wall: In conventional Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) [ 36 ] , an autoencoder (such as the FLUX.2 VAE [ 4 ] ) compresses images into a regularized latent space. At high resolutions ( 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ), storing pre-computed 32-channel float16 latents for hundreds of thousands of images requires multiple terabytes of high-speed storage, exceeding consumer NVMe capacities. Consequently, latents must be computed on-the-fly. On consumer silicon during the training stage, the frozen VAE forward pass consumes ≈ 60 % \approx 60\% of total wall-time, whereas a compiled 200M DiT forward-backward pass requires only ≈ 35 % \approx 35\% (Figure 7 in Appendix A ). Furthermore, at inference, VAE decoding accounts for over 70% of wall-clock latency under few-step regimes, creating a computational bottleneck for downstream reinforcement learning (e.g., Flow-GRPO [ 28 ] ) and distillation.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce Asuka-FM , an end-to-end system and architectural co-design framework proving that a competitive ∼ \sim 206M-parameter Dual-Stream DiT can be pretrained from scratch on a single desktop GPU in ∼ \sim 160 GPU hours for under $55 1 1 1 Compute costs are benchmarked against RunPod Community Cloud on-demand rates as of October 2026: $0.33/GPU-hour for consumer NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB GDDR6X) and $0.40/GPU-hour for datacenter NVIDIA A40 (48GB GDDR6). . As showcased in Figure 2 , our open-domain model achieves sharp textural coherence, rich lighting, and diverse multi-concept synthesis (additional domain-specialized anime samples are shown in Figure 19 in Appendix H ). To achieve this efficiency, we propose a multi-stage training roadmap (Figure 3 ) coupling structured sequence sparsification, canvas scaling, and latent-to-pixel adaptation. Our primary contributions are: • System-Architectural Pretraining Recipe: We establish an engineering pipeline integrating in-RAM latent caching for low-resolution stages, network streaming for intermediate scales, and FlashAttention-2 kernel fusion within a fully static torch.compile execution graph. This setup sustains an average 75.6% physical MFU act \text{MFU}_{\text{act}} on a single consumer RTX 4090 GPU. • High-Efficiency Dual-Stream Architecture: We couple an AdaLN-free Dual-Stream DiT backbone with three synergistic mechanisms: (i) SPRINT sequence sparsification [ 33 ] , routing 75%-sparse token sequences through 9 heavy middle blocks to slash attention FLOPs by over 50%; (ii) Continuous Aspect-Normalized RoPE and shifted square cropping [ 47 , 44 ] , supported by a mathematical derivation proving that uncalibrated continuous RoPE undergoes spatial phase collapse, and a full-spectrum frequency calibration that ensures isotropic decay while conferring zero-shot virtual camera control; and (iii) Decoupled Latent-to-Pixel Adaptation, which attaches a lightweight (10M parameter) convolutional Patch Detailer Head (PDH) [ 11 ] under native velocity regression ( v v -prediction) to eliminate the online VAE wall. • Empirical Ablations and Profiling with Systems Analysis: We discover an Amortization Asymmetry : while pixel adaptation eliminates the online VAE encoding wall during pretraining, its recurrent convolutional evaluation makes standard multi-step sampling ( N ≥ 13 N\geq 13 ) slower than latent ODE integration, delivering superior efficiency exclusively in few-step regimes ( N ≤ 8 N\leq 8 , yielding up to 3.34 × 3.34\times speedups at N = 1 N=1 step). • Open-Domain Validation: Trained on a balanced 625K multi-source open corpus without benchmark-specific fine-tuning (avoiding BLIP3o-60K overfitting), Asuka-FM achieves a GenEval score of 0.588 and DPG-Bench score of 78.96 at 256px (68h), converging to 0.609 GenEval and 78.51 DPG-Bench at 512px (81h).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers and Conditioning Paradigms. The transition from U-Nets to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 34 ] established transformers as the standard generative backbone. Multi-Modal DiTs (MMDiT) in SD3 [ 16 ] , FLUX.1 [ 3 ] utilize separate weights per modality with shared self-attention, while single-stream models (Lumina-T2X [ 18 ] , Z-Image [ 40 ] ) concatenate modalities directly. To eliminate parameter overhead from per-block Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN-Zero), DiT-Air [ 6 ] shared AdaLN parameters globally. While Peebles & Xie [ 34 ] initially explored concatenating class tokens in single-stream models, i ​ 1 i1 [ 49 ] showed that explicit modulation can be entirely omitted when stabilized by Sandwich RMSNorm [ 15 ] and SwiGLU activations [ 38 ] . Asuka-FM adopts this principle by replacing AdaLN with in-context temporal conditioning, prepending a continuous sinusoidal timestep token directly to the multimodal sequence.
blocks.zh: 分化变形器与条件变形器. 从U-Nets到扩散变压器(DiTs)的过渡[34]建立了变压器作为标准的基因主干. SD3 [16],FLUX.1 [3] 中的多模态二Ts(MMDIT)直接使用每个模式的单独权重,同时使用单流模型(Lumina-T2X [18],Z-Image [40])直接结合模式. 为了从每个区块的适应层常态化(AdaLN-Zero)中去除参数的间接,DiT-Air [6] 在全球共享AdaLN参数. 虽然 Peebles & Xie [34] 最初在单流模型中探索了调值类符号,i 1 i1 [49] 显示,当Sunvey RMSNorm [15] 和 SwiGLU 激活 [38] 稳定时,可以完全省略明确的调值. Asuka-FM采用这一原则,将AdaLN替换为文字中的时间规定,将连续的sinoidal时间步符号直接用于多式联运序列。

blocks.en: Sequence Sparsification and Token Dropping. Because self-attention complexity scales as 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) with sequence length N N , token dropping provides significant acceleration. MaskDiT [ 50 ] and MDTv2 [ 19 ] introduced masked autoencoding objectives, while TREAD [ 25 ] bypassed subsets of tokens through inner layers. SPRINT [ 33 ] demonstrated that structural specialization—combining a dense shallow encoder ( f θ f_{\theta} ), a 75%-sparse middle path ( g θ g_{\theta} ), and a dense decoder ( h θ h_{\theta} ) fused via linear skips—permits aggressive token dropping without fidelity loss. We extend SPRINT to open-domain multimodal conditioning and evaluate its scaling limits.
blocks.zh: 序列分解与托肯滴水. 由于自觉复杂度的尺度为O QQ(N 2 )\ mathcal{O}(N^{2}),序列长度为N N,所以信使下降提供了显著的加速. MaskDIT [50] 和 MDTv2 [19] 引入了蒙面自动编码目标,而 TREAD [25] 则通过内层绕过符号的子集. SPRINT[33]表明,结构专业化——将密集的浅层编码器(f θ f_{\theta})、75%的散热中间路径(g θ g_{\theta})和密集的解码器(h θ h_{\theta})组成线性跳动——允许在不丧失忠诚的情况下主动下降。 我们把SPRINT扩大到开放域的多式联运条件,并评估其规模限制。

blocks.en: Looped Transformers: Parameter-Efficient Depth Scaling. Looped transformers [ 14 , 20 , 12 ] achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared group of middle transformer blocks. In Looped-DiT [ 12 ] , cycling through shared blocks keeps weights resident in on-chip SRAM and L2 cache, mitigating memory bandwidth bottlenecks. While looped models compress parameter count across recurrent depth, Asuka-FM focuses on sequence-length compression via SPRINT, providing complementary architectural paths toward efficient pretraining.
blocks.zh: 循环变压器:参数-有效深度放大。 循环变压器[14,20,12]通过反复执行一组共享的中间变压器块来实现参数效率. 在Looped-DIT [12]中,通过共享块的循环使积分常居于芯片SRAM和L2缓存中,缓解内存带宽瓶颈. Asuka-FM在通过SPRINT进行序列长压缩的同时,通过循环模型将参数压缩到整个反复深度,为高效的预训提供了互补的建筑路径.

blocks.en: Micro-Budget Foundation Modeling and Pixel Diffusion. Micro-budget training has gained significant attention. Stretching Each Dollar [ 37 ] demonstrated T2I pretraining from scratch for $1,890 on 8 × \times H100s using mixture-of-experts and deferred masking. Concurrently, HDM [ 47 ] trained a 343M model for $535–620 on 4 × \times RTX 5090 GPUs using shifted square cropping and aspect-normalized RoPE with learnable frequency parameters. In pixel-space diffusion, early works suffered from slow convergence [ 22 , 8 ] . JiT [ 26 ] and Jiang et al. [ 24 ] advocated clean data prediction ( x 0 x_{0} -prediction), but Iris-3B [ 5 ] showed that velocity regression ( v v -prediction) provides equal stability. DiP [ 11 ] introduced the Patch Detailer Head (PDH) to bridge latent efficiency with pixel generation. Asuka-FM synthesizes these insights into an integrated low-cost training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 微预算基金会建模与像素扩散. 微额预算培训受到很大关注。 每美元[37]的伸展表明,T2I从零开始在8xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 同时,HDM [47]在4 ×x\times RTX 5090 GPU上用可学习的频率参数,对343M型号进行了训练,以535–620美元为标准. 在像素-空间传播中,早期的作品出现缓慢的趋同[22,8]. JiT [26]和Jiang等人. [24] 主张清洁数据预测(x0 x_{0} - 预测),但Iris-3B [5] 显示速度回归(v v - 预测)提供同等稳定性. DiP [11] 引入了补丁细节头(PDH),将潜在效率与像素生成连接起来. Asuka-FM将这些见解合成一个综合的低成本培训管道。

blocks.en: 4 Asuka-FM Framework
blocks.zh: 4. Asuka-FM框架

blocks.en: Asuka-FM establishes an end-to-end system and architectural framework designed to train high-capacity Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) from scratch within limited consumer-compute budgets. Our work extends the Micro-Budget Foundation Modeling research to an even more accessible boundary: pretraining a 206M Dual-Stream DiT on a single consumer workstation equipped with an RTX 4090 GPU in 161.2 hours. Furthermore, the random square crops training [ 44 ] and the multi-captioning strategy of i ​ 1 i1 [ 49 ] demonstrate that a capable foundation model can be trained from scratch on fewer than one million images.
blocks.zh: Asuka-FM建立了一个端对端系统和建筑框架,目的是在有限的消费者计算预算范围内从零开始培训大容量分散变压器。 我们的工作将微预算基金会的模型研究扩展到一个更加容易进入的界限:在161.2小时内对一个配备了RTX 4090 GPU的单一消费者工作站预先培训一台206M型双层DiT。 此外,随机方块作物培训[44]和i 1 i1[49]的多封式战略表明,可以在不到100万图像上从头到尾地培训一个有能力的基础模型。

blocks.en: Rather than relying on massive parameter scaling or distributed multi-node infrastructure, the framework co-designs the model architecture, memory hierarchy, and training curriculum around four complementary pillars: 1. Minimalist Dual-Stream Backbone (Section 4.1 ): Completely eliminates per-block modulation overhead reducing compute and parameters. 2. Structured Sequence Sparsification via SPRINT (Section 4.2 ): Reduces attention FLOPs by over 50% while providing strong regularization. 3. Continuous Aspect-Normalized RoPE & Shifted Cropping (Section 4.3 ): Prevents rotary phase collapse, enforces static tensor shapes to eliminate JIT compilation breaks, and provides zero-shot virtual camera controls (pan and zoom). 4. Decoupled Latent-to-Pixel Adaptation (Section 4.5 ): Transfers converged latent priors directly into raw pixel space, permanently bypassing the autoencoder decoding latency wall during downstream inference and reinforcement learning rollouts.
blocks.zh: 框架不依赖大规模参数的缩放或分布式多节点基础设施,而是围绕四个互补支柱共同设计模型架构、内存等级和培训课程: 1. 最小的双层背骨(第4.1节): 完全取消每个区块的调制间接费用,减少计算和参数。 2. 通过SPRINT进行结构化序列分解(第4.2节): 将注意力减少50%以上,同时提供有力的正规化。 3. 连续无标的 RoPE 和移位作物(第4.3节): 防止旋转相位崩溃,执行静态拉伸形状来消除JIT编译中断,并提供零镜头虚拟相机控制(pan和缩放). 4. 脱钩的Latent-to-Pixel适应(第4.5节): 在下游推导和加固学习展开期间,转移的潜伏前身直接汇合到原始像素空间,永久绕过自动编码器解码层壁.

blocks.en: Asuka-FM employs a 206M-parameter Dual-Stream DiT backbone optimized for single-GPU execution (Table 1 ). Standard AdaLN-Zero requires projecting conditioning embeddings into six independent affine modulation parameters per residual stream across every layer, introducing non-compute parameter overhead and intermediate memory traffic. Following i ​ 1 i1 [ 49 ] , we eliminate per-block AdaLN modulation layers. blocks.en: Standard discrete integer positional encodings fail when generalizing across variable aspect ratios, inducing artifacts. To resolve this, previous work [ 47 ] treats vertical and horizontal spatial frequencies as learnable parameters ( ω h , ω w ∈ ℝ N H × ( d h / 4 ) \omega_{h},\omega_{w}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{H}\times(d_{h}/4)} for patch-grid height N H N_{H} and head dimension d h d_{h} ) initialized via log-spaced heuristics. In contrast, Asuka-FM establishes a parameter-free continuous coordinate formulation. We mathematically diagnose why naive continuous RoPE undergoes spatial phase collapse and derive a closed-form, calibrated frequency spectrum that achieves isotropic decay without optimizer overhead.

blocks.en: 4.5 Latent-to-Pixel Decoupling via DiP Head
blocks.zh: 4.5 通过DiP头进行梯级对像素脱钩

blocks.en: While latent diffusion provides rapid semantic pretraining, the frozen VAE decoder imposes latency bottlenecks during few-step inference and online reinforcement learning rollouts (e.g., Flow-GRPO [ 28 ] ). We bridge this trade-off by pretraining in latent space and transferring to raw pixel space via a lightweight convolutional Patch Detailer Head (PDH) based on DiP [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然潜在的传播提供了快速的语义预修,但冻结的VAE解码器在几步推论和在线强化学习的推出(如Flow-GRPO [28])过程中,却造成了延迟瓶颈. 我们通过在潜在空间进行预训,并通过基于DiP [11]的轻量级的补丁细节头(PDH)转移到原始像素空间,来弥补这种权衡。

blocks.en: PDH Architecture. Patch-level visual tokens s i ∈ ℝ D s_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} ( i ∈ { 1 , … , N } i\in\{1,\dots,N\} ) emitted by the DiT decoder h θ h_{\theta} are mapped into raw RGB patches via a 4-stage convolutional U-Net adding only 10.09M parameters ( ≈ 5 × \approx 5\times smaller than standard autoencoder decoders). To prevent high-frequency aliasing from transposed convolutions, Asuka-FM employs nearest-neighbor upsampling coupled with 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions ( Upsample + Conv2d ). blocks.en: Direct Velocity Regression vs. Clean Data Prediction. Previous pixel diffusion studies [ 24 , 26 ] advocated clean data prediction ( x 0 x_{0} -prediction). However, converting predicted clean states x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} into velocity targets v t v_{t} from noisy pixel states x t x_{t} at timestep t t via Eq. ( 1 ), v t = ( x t − x ^ 0 ) / t v_{t}=(x_{t}-\hat{x}_{0})/t , introduces mathematical instability. As t → 0 t\to 0 , this conversion suffers from division-by-zero singularities under bfloat16, requiring artificial clamping and dynamic percentile clipping that flattens dynamic range and induces chromatic blowout. In contrast, our ablations (corroborated by Iris-3B [ 5 ] ) demonstrate that direct velocity regression ( v v -prediction) is superior. Retaining native v v -prediction preserves continuous probability paths, stabilizes optimization, and eliminates the need for dynamic activation clipping.

blocks.en: We evaluate Asuka-FM across two benchmarks: GenEval [ 21 ] and DPG-Bench [ 23 ] (Table 3 ; the complete GenEval breakdown is provided in Table 9 of Appendix A ). At 256 × 256 256\times 256 , Asuka-FM achieves GenEval of 0.588 and DPG-Bench of 78.96 . When scaling to 512 × 512 512\times 512 under 75% SPRINT token dropping (Phase 2A), performance temporarily drops to 0.480 0.480 on GenEval and 68.40 68.40 on DPG-Bench due to fine spatial binding degradation (color attribution drops from 41.75% to 16.25%). However, full-sequence dense refinement (Phase 2B) rapidly restores high-frequency fidelity: within 20,000 steps, DPG-Bench surges to 79.49, converging at Epoch 139 to 0.609 GenEval and 78.51 DPG-Bench .
blocks.zh: 我们对Asuka-FM的评价分为两个基准:GenEval[21]和DPG-Bench[23](表3;附录A表9提供了GenEval的全部细目)。 Asuka-FM在256×256256\times 256中,实现了GenEval 0.588和DPG-Bench 78.96. 当缩放到512×512 512\时,512 低于75%的 SPRINT 令牌下降(第2A阶段)时,由于空间绑定性退化(颜色归属从41.75%降至16.25%),GenEval上的性能暂时下降到0.480 0.480,DPG-Bench上的性能暂时下降到68.40 68.40。 然而,全序密集的精炼(第2B阶段)迅速恢复了高频忠诚度:在20,000步内,DPG-Bench猛增到79.49步,在Epoch 139至0.609 GenEval和78.51 DPG-Bench汇合.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol and Checkpoint selection. To ensure strict reproducibility, benchmarks are evaluated using a 100-step Euler ODE solver. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) scale is set to w cfg = 8.0 w_{\text{cfg}}=8.0 at 256 2 256^{2} and reduced to w cfg = 6.0 w_{\text{cfg}}=6.0 at 512 2 512^{2} to prevent contrast blowout. We explicitly select Epoch 139 over the 20k-step checkpoint despite the slight 0.98-point variance in DPG: extended training improves fine-grained multi-object binding, with color attribution rising from 0.358 to 0.450 and two-object layout rising from 0.788 to 0.811 (Table 9 ).

blocks.en: Contextualizing Benchmark Fine-Tuning. As documented in prior evaluations [ 49 , 46 ] , several academic baselines (e.g., Looped-DiT, MiniT2I, DeCo) report scores following fine-tuning on the BLIP3o-60K prompt dataset [ 7 ] , which directly aligns models to GenEval syntactic patterns. In contrast, Asuka-FM is evaluated strictly as an open-domain foundation model trained on general multi-source data without benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Even without specialized prompt tuning, Asuka-FM’s DPG-Bench score ( 78.51 ​ – ​ 79.49 78.51\text{--}79.49 ) is highly competitive with models trained on massive clusters (DeCo at 81.40, SDXL at 72.40), while outperforming SDXL on GenEval ( 0.609 ​ vs. ​ 0.406 0.609\text{ vs. }0.406 ).

blocks.en: We profile kernel execution across consumer and datacenter silicon: RTX 4090 (24GB GDDR6X, Ada Lovelace) and NVIDIA A40 (48GB GDDR6, Ampere) under identical software stacks (Table 5 ; see Table 10 in Appendix A for complete resolution and token sequence specifications).

blocks.en: The VRAM and Peak TFLOPS Analysis. The A40 provides double the physical VRAM (48GB vs. 24GB) and comparable rated compute ( ∼ \sim 150 TFLOPS). However, at batch size 64, the RTX 4090 completes each compiled step in 308.27 ​ ms 308.27\,\text{ms} ( 84.22 ​ TFLOPS 84.22\,\text{TFLOPS} , MFU act = 50.98 % \text{MFU}_{\text{act}}=50.98\% ), whereas the A40 requires 607.65 ​ ms 607.65\,\text{ms} ( 44.43 ​ TFLOPS 44.43\,\text{TFLOPS} , MFU act = 26.90 % \text{MFU}_{\text{act}}=26.90\% ). The consumer GPU executes identical workloads 1.97 × 1.97\times faster . Peak memory allocation reaches only 15.25 ​ GB 15.25\,\text{GB} on the RTX 4090; the extra 34.75 GB on the A40 remains completely idle.

blocks.en:
Micro-Architectural Drivers. This divergence is driven by two factors:
(i) 12 × \times L2 Cache Differential (72 MB vs. 6 MB): Under torch.compile , TorchInductor fuses projections, norms, and SwiGLU gating into compound Triton kernels. On Ada Lovelace, the 72 MB L2 cache keeps intermediate activations resident in on-chip SRAM across kernel invocations. On Ampere (6 MB L2), batched sequence activations ( N batch = B ⋅ N = 16,384 N_{\text{batch}}=B\cdot N=16{,}384 tokens/step) overflow, thrashing memory buses.
(ii) DRAM Bandwidth Starvation (1,008 GB/s vs. 696 GB/s): When cache overflows, the A40 falls back to GDDR6 memory ( 31 % 31\% slower). Memory-bound phases suffer heavy penalties: text encoder forward is 2.57 × 2.57\times slower on A40 ( 99.98 ​ ms vs. ​ 38.94 ​ ms 99.98\,\text{ms vs. }38.94\,\text{ms} ), and AdamW steps are 1.74 × 1.74\times slower ( 36.33 ​ ms vs. ​ 20.87 ​ ms 36.33\,\text{ms vs. }20.87\,\text{ms} ).

blocks.en: The Online VAE Wall at 512px and 1MP. Profiling at 512 × 512 512\times 512 on the A40 under online VAE encoding (Table 5 ) shows that in-place VAE encoding consumes 2,263.52 ​ ms 2,263.52\,\text{ms} out of 3,808.42 ​ ms 3,808.42\,\text{ms} per step ( 59.4 % 59.4\% of wall-clock time; see Figure 7 in Appendix A for resolution breakdown), dragging end-to-end system MFU down to 15.27 % 15.27\% . This bottleneck intensifies at native 1-megapixel ( 1024 × 1024 , N = 4096 1024\times 1024,N=4096 tokens): caching uncompressed 32-channel float16 latents for 337k samples requires over 1.2 ​ TB 1.2\,\text{TB} of storage, exceeding consumer NVMe capacities and forcing on-the-fly encoding. Profiling at micro-batch size B = 8 B=8 on a single RTX 4090 reveals that the frozen VAE encoder consumes 164.92 ​ ms 164.92\,\text{ms} per step ( 62.0% of total step latency , 265.44 ​ ms 265.44\,\text{ms} compiled), whereas the DiT forward and backward passes execute in 23.70 ​ ms 23.70\,\text{ms} and 44.50 ​ ms 44.50\,\text{ms} respectively ( < 70 ​ ms <70\,\text{ms} combined). Because the frozen autoencoder runs 2.42 × 2.42\times slower than the generative backbone, physical hardware MFU is capped at 14.5 % ​ – ​ 26.2 % 14.5\%\text{--}26.2\% —establishing the primary systems motivation for our autoencoder-free latent-to-pixel adaptation strategy (preliminary 1MP SPRINT scaling diagnostics on the Danbooru corpus are deferred to Appendix G ).

blocks.zh: 6.5 晚到像素力学的经验分析

blocks.en: Critically, converting predicted clean states x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} into velocity targets v t = ( x t − x ^ 0 ) / t v_{t}=(x_{t}-\hat{x}_{0})/t introduces a fatal singularity as t → 0 t\to 0 in bfloat16 , requiring dynamic percentile clipping that flattens dynamic range and induces chromatic blowout. In contrast, native v v -prediction maintained smooth optimization trajectories with zero activation clipping, completely avoiding color desaturation.
blocks.zh: 关键是,将预测的清洁状态 x ^ 0\ hat{x}_{0} 转换为速度目标 v t = (x t - x ^ 0) / t v_{t}=(x_{t} -\ hat{x}_{0})/ t 引入一个致命的奇点,作为 bfloat16 中的 t → 0 t\\ 0, 需要动态百分位剪切以平整动态范围并诱发色爆. 相比之下,原生 v - 预测维持了零激活剪辑的平滑优化轨迹,完全避免了颜色脱饱.

While compositional binding declines under the larger patch stride (DPG-Bench drops to 69.87, GenEval to 0.504), sampling latency at 512 2 512^{2} on an NVIDIA A40 drops to 0.187 ​ s 0.187\,\text{s} (20 steps) and 0.277 ​ s 0.277\,\text{s} (30 steps, a 1.78 × 1.78\times speedup over P = 16 P=16 ), establishing an ultra-fast sampling engine for compute-critical applications.

blocks.en: 6.6 Inference Profiling: The Amortization Asymmetry
blocks.zh: 6.6 推论:摊还不对称

blocks.en: A common assumption in pixel diffusion literature [ 11 ] is that eliminating the VAE decoder accelerates inference. Profiling across N ∈ { 20 , 30 } N\in\{20,30\} sampling steps on an NVIDIA A40 (Table 11 ) reveals an Amortization Asymmetry : for standard multi-step sampling ( N ∈ { 20 , 30 } N\in\{20,30\} ), pixel diffusion is actually 9 % ​ – ​ 31 % 9\%\text{--}31\% slower than latent diffusion. At 1024 2 1024^{2} (batch size B = 16 B=16 ), generating 30-step trajectories requires 46.43 ​ s 46.43\,\text{s} in latent mode versus 53.28 ​ s 53.28\,\text{s} in pixel mode ( 14.8 % 14.8\% slower).
blocks.zh: 在像素扩散文献中一个常见的假设[11]是消除VAE解码器加速推论. 在NVIDIA A40(表11)上的N\ { { 20, 30}} N\ in\ 20, 30} 采样步骤 显示一个分级不对称: 对于标准的多步骤采样(N\ { { 20, 30} N\ in\ 20, 30}), 像素扩散实际上为9% — 31 % 9\ { { { }31} 慢于潜在扩散。 在 1024 2 1024 \\\2}(批量大小 B = 16 B = 16 )时,生成30步轨距需要46.43 s 46.43\\,\text{s}在潜伏模式下与 53.28 s 53.28\,\text{s}在像素模式下(14.8% 14.8\xxx).

blocks.en: Deconstructing the Asymmetry. Total sampling latency over N N ODE steps decomposes into per-step evaluation latency t step t_{\text{step}} and fixed terminal decoding overhead t fixed t_{\text{fixed}} : Total Time ​ ( N ) = N ⋅ t step + t fixed \text{Total Time}(N)=N\cdot t_{\text{step}}+t_{\text{fixed}} . In latent sampling, terminal VAE decoding incurs a one-time fixed penalty ( t fixed, latent = 4.82 ​ s t_{\text{fixed, latent}}=4.82\,\text{s} at 1024 2 1024^{2} ), while per-step latency remains low ( t step, latent = 1.387 ​ s t_{\text{step, latent}}=1.387\,\text{s} per batch step). In pixel sampling, while the VAE overhead is eliminated ( t fixed, pixel = 0.09 ​ s ≈ 0 t_{\text{fixed, pixel}}=0.09\,\text{s}\approx 0 ), the convolutional PDH head must evaluate recurrently at every step (and twice per step under CFG), increasing per-step latency to t step, pixel = 1.773 ​ s t_{\text{step, pixel}}=1.773\,\text{s} (+27.8%). Across 30 steps, this recurrent overhead accumulates to 11.58 ​ s 11.58\,\text{s} , completely eclipsing the 4.82 ​ s 4.82\,\text{s} VAE decode savings.
blocks.zh: 解构无对称. N N ODE 步骤上的总采样间隔将分解为每步评价 latency t step t\ t\ t\ t\ step\ 和固定终端解码 间接费用 t\ t\ t\ t\ fixed\ : 总时间 (N) = N + t step + t fixed\ text{总时间} (N) = N\ cdot t\ t\ t\ step\ t\ t\ fixed\ 。 在潜伏取样中,终端VAE解码会受到一次性固定的处罚(t固定,潜伏=4.82 s t_{\text{固定,潜伏=4.82\,\text{s}在1024 2 1024^{2}),而每步骤的延迟度仍然很低(t步骤,潜伏=1.387 s t_{\text{步,潜伏=1.387\,\text{s}每批步骤)。 在像素采样中,虽然VAE的俯仰面被消除(t固定,像素=0.09 s ≈ 0 t_{\text{固定,像素=0.09\,\text{\\\\\大约0),但革命性的PDH头必须在每个步骤(在CFG下每步两次)进行反复评价,将每步间歇度提升到T步,像素=1.773 s t_{\text{步,像素=1}}=1.773\,\text{s}(+27.8%). 在30个步骤中,这种经常性的间接费用累积到11.58 s 11.58\,\text{s},完全抹去了4.82 s 4.82\,\text{s} VAE解码节省.

blocks.en: Crossover Dynamics and Operational Regimes. Equating both linear trajectories yields an empirical break-even crossover threshold of N ∗ ≈ 12.25 N^{*}\approx 12.25 sampling steps (formal derivation in Appendix A.4 ), cleanly partitioning operational utility (Figure 6 ). For multi-step regimes ( N ≥ 13 N\geq 13 steps), latent sampling is strictly faster because the O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) VAE decode is amortized across many steps. Conversely, in few-step regimes ( N ≤ 8 N\leq 8 steps), pixel diffusion is decisively superior: under 4-step distilled sampling (DMD2 [ 48 ] ), pixel latency is 7.18 ​ s 7.18\,\text{s} ( 0.449 ​ s/img 0.449\,\text{s/img} ) versus 10.37 ​ s 10.37\,\text{s} ( 0.648 ​ s/img 0.648\,\text{s/img} ) for latent mode (a 1.44 × 1.44\times speedup ). At N = 1 N=1 step, pixel mode achieves a 3.34 × 3.34\times acceleration , establishing pixel models as natural engines for distilled few-step rollout.

blocks.en: 6.7 Manifold Support: Square Synthetics vs. Multi-Aspect Corpora
blocks.zh: 6.7 操纵支持: Square合成对多视角公司

blocks.en: An empirical discovery is the divergence in camera controllability across training distributions. Models trained on synthetic open-domain datasets (e.g., FLUX-Reason-6M, Midjourney-v6) exhibit geometric warping and background collapse on some prompts during coordinate manipulation. Synthetic datasets are mainly generated as centered 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 squares. Extracting shifted square crops from square-native images forcibly clips through canonical focal points, teaching the model that off-center coordinate queries correlate with truncated subjects.
blocks.zh: 一个经验发现是,在培训分布方面,相机可控性存在差异。 接受过合成开放域数据集培训的模型(如FLUX-Reason-6M,Midjourney-v6)在坐标操纵过程中在一些导线上显示出几何扭曲和背景崩溃. 合成数据集主要是作为中心1024×1024 1024\times 1024平方而生成的. 将方块作物从方块成像中抽取出来,通过犬科联系点强行剪辑,教授一种模式,即非中心点协调查询与截断对象相关。

blocks.en: In contrast, our curated Danbooru corpus naturally spans non-square aspect ratios ( 1 : 2 1:2 portrait pin-ups to 21 : 9 21:9 panoramic spreads). Performing shifted cropping on raw rectangular illustrations forces the continuous RoPE manifold to encounter the entire coordinate spectrum [ − r H , r H ] × [ − r W , r W ] [-r_{H},r_{H}]\times[-r_{W},r_{W}] over diverse, naturally framed focal points and perspective depths. Consequently, the anime-specialized model establishes genuine spatial invariance, unlocking robust zero-shot virtual camera manipulation without auxiliary conditioning tokens.
blocks.zh: 与此相对照,我们所编的丹布鲁格自然跨越非平方的侧面比(1:2 1:2肖像披针形到21:9 21:9全景差). 在原始长方形插图上进行裁剪,迫使连续的 RoPE 倍数遇到整个坐标谱[− r H, r H] × [− r_{H], r_{H]\ times [-r_{W}, r_{W} 超过各种自然设定的联络点和视角深度。 因此,动能专用模型建立了真正的空间偏移,解锁了强大的零镜头虚拟相机操纵,没有辅助的调节符.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论、限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: Limitations. While Asuka-FM achieves competitive synthesis on a single consumer GPU, several limitations remain: (i) Pretraining was conducted on 625,000 samples; multi-billion parameter models trained on hundreds of millions of images remain superior on complex crowd scenes and long-tail concepts. (ii) Although our corpus includes TextAtlas5M [ 41 ] , the 206M backbone does not consistently render multi-word text strings. (iii) In pixel space, multi-step sampling ( N ≥ 13 N\geq 13 steps) without patch enlargement ( P = 16 P=16 ) exhibits higher latency than latent diffusion due to recurrent PDH evaluation.
blocks.zh: 限制。 虽然Asuka-FM在单一消费GPU上实现了竞争性合成,但仍有一些限制:(一) 对62.5万个样本进行了Pretraining;在复杂人群场景和长尾概念上,对数亿个图像进行了培训的参数模型仍然优越。 (二) 虽然我们的教程包括TextAtlas5M[41],但206M骨干并没有一致地使多字文字串. (三)在像素空间中,多步采样(N ≥ 13 N\ geq 13 step),不增加补丁(P = 16 P = 16),由于经常的PDH评价,显示出比潜在传播更高的耐久性.

blocks.en:
Future Work. Immediate research will expand along two directions:
(i) Native 1MP Scaling Curriculum: Building on our preliminary 1MP profiling (Appendix G ).
(ii) Zero-Decode Downstream Post-Training (Flow-GRPO): In Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning [ 28 ] , generating G = 12 G=12 rollouts per prompt requires 12 independent VAE decodes in latent mode ( > 60 % >60\% of GPU memory). By emitting direct RGB tensors, our pixel model eliminates this decoding bottleneck, enabling scalable online RL on consumer workstations.
blocks.zh:
未来工作。 即时研究将沿着两个方向扩展:
(一) 土著1MP扩展课程: 以我们初步的1MP剖面分析(附录G)为基础。
(二)0-Decode 下游培训后(Flow-GRPO):在Flow-GRPO强化学习[28]中,生成G=12G=12的推出每时速需要12个在潜伏模式下的独立VAE解码( > 60%>60\%). 我们的像素模型通过排放直接的RGB测距器,消除了这个解码瓶颈,使得消费者工作站的在线RL可以伸缩.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Asuka-FM demonstrates that high-resolution text-to-image foundation models do not fundamentally require datacenter-scale compute clusters. By synthesizing an AdaLN-free dual-stream backbone with prepended temporal conditioning, structured sequence sparsification via SPRINT, continuous aspect-normalized RoPE with shifted square crop training, and decoupled latent-to-pixel adaptation via a lightweight Patch Detailer Head, Asuka-FM successfully trains a 206M latent generative foundation model from scratch on a single consumer NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU in 161.2 wall-clock hours, executing 65.65 ExaFLOPs for only $53.2 in compute .
blocks.zh: Asuka-FM显示,高分辨率文本对图像基础模型根本不需要数据中心尺度的计算集群. Asuka-FM通过将AdaLN无双流骨干与预留时间调节合成,通过SPRINT进行结构化的序列螺旋化,通过转动方块作物训练进行连续的侧面规范化RoPE,并通过轻量级补丁板头来解开潜对像素的适应,在161.2小时的时钟里,Asuka-FM在单一消费的NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上成功从零开始训练206M潜基因基模型,执行65.65 ExaFLOP,在计算中仅53.2美元.

blocks.en: Operating on the Pareto frontier of denoiser compute ( 0.0657 ​ ZFLOPs 0.0657\text{ ZFLOPs} ), Asuka-FM achieves a GenEval score of 0.609 and DPG-Bench score of 78.51 at 512px without benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Micro-architectural profiling reveals an Amortization Asymmetry: while pixel adaptation eliminates the online VAE wall during pretraining and delivers up to 3.34 × 3.34\times speedups in few-step regimes ( N ≤ 4 N\leq 4 sampling steps), latent sampling remains faster for multi-step trajectories ( N ≥ 13 N\geq 13 steps). Asuka-FM provides an empirical and systems foundation for accessible, low-budget generative foundation modeling across academic and independent research laboratories.
blocks.zh: Asuka-FM在denoiser compute(0.0657 ZFLOPs 0.0657\text{ZFLOPs})的Pareto边界上运行,在512px上实现了0.609的GenEval得分和78.51的DPG-Bench得分,没有特定基准的微调. 微结构剖面显示存在Amortization不对称现象:虽然像素适应在预训期间消除了在线的VAE墙,并在几步制下提供高达3.34×3.34\时速(N 4 N\leq 4采样步骤),但对于多步轨迹而言,潜在采样速度仍然较快(N\ 13 N\geq 13步)。 Asuka-FM为在学术和独立研究实验室之间建立无障碍、低预算的基因基础模型提供了一个经验和系统基础。

blocks.en: D.2 Failure Modes and Generation Artifacts
blocks.zh: D.2 故障模式和生成装置

blocks.en: While Asuka-FM achieves competitive open-domain synthesis (0.609 GenEval, 78.51 DPG-Bench) within a limited compute envelope ( ∼ \sim 160 GPU hours), the model exhibits localized failure modes when subjected to out-of-distribution prompts. Figure 14 provides an explicit comparative ablation.
blocks.zh: 虽然Asuka-FM在有限的计算信封内实现竞争性的开放域合成(0.609 GenEval, 78.51 DPG-Bench),但模型在受分配外提示时显示局部故障模式. 图14提供了明确的比较数据。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Failure mode comparison under continuous RoPE zoom on a complex organic composition. (a) At canonical scale ( z = 1.0 × z=1.0\times ), the 206M dual-stream backbone synthesizes a coherent scene with sharp lighting, structured perspective, and clean floral silhouettes. (b) Applying continuous RoPE focal zoom ( z > 1.0 × z>1.0\times ) compresses the evaluation grid, inducing: (i) painterly high-frequency texture smearing on the stone pathway, (ii) semantic attribute bleeding (pink pigment leaking into ground cobblestones), and (iii) spatial non-rigidity and warping along linear wooden bench slats.
blocks.zh: 图14:连续ROPE下失败模式比较,放大复杂有机成分. 在犬形尺度(z = 1.0 × z = 1.0\times)下,206M双流骨干合成一个连贯的场景,带有尖锐的照明,结构化的视角,以及清洁的植物花序. (b) 应用连续的 RoPE 焦距放大(z > 1.0 × z > 1.0\times)压缩评价网格,诱导:(一) 画家在石头通道上进行高频纹理涂抹,(二) 语义属性出血(平板颜料渗入地面卵石),(三) 空间不固定,沿线性木板凳斜拉。

blocks.en: A systematic analysis reveals that these artifacts are not structural flaws of the base generator, but rather emerge from the physical limits of continuous coordinate scaling:
blocks.zh: 系统分析显示,这些文物并非基建生成器的结构缺陷,而是从连续坐标缩放的物理限制中产生的:

blocks.en: As demonstrated in Figure 14 (a), the base model readily generates coherent cobblestones, realistic foliage distributions, and consistent depth-of-field. However, when focal zoom ( z > 1.0 × z>1.0\times ) is applied (Figure 14 (b)), the coordinate grid contracts, forcing each patch of effective pixel stride P = 16 P=16 to cover a smaller physical subregion of the scene. Because the compact 206M backbone lacks multi-scale texture detailers or sub-patch supervision, it cannot hallucinate micro-surface details (e.g., individual stone crevices or fine wood grain). The model consequently defaults to smooth velocity trajectories, producing the waxy, painterly swirls visible in the foreground path.
blocks.zh: 如图14(a)所示,基础模型很容易产生连贯的卵石、现实的叶片分布和一致的野外深度。 然而,当使用焦距缩放(z > 1.0 × z > 1.0\times)时(图14(b)),坐标网格合同,强迫每个补丁的有效像素stride P=16 P=16覆盖场景中一个较小的物理分区. 由于紧凑的206M骨干缺乏多尺度的纹理细化器或副patch监理,因此无法产生微表层细节的幻觉(如单个石屑或细细的木质谷物). 该模型因此默认了平滑的速度轨迹,产生了在前方路径中可见的蜡质,画质的旋动.

blocks.en: Recall that r W r_{W} denotes the aspect-ratio width scale factor, N W N_{W} the horizontal patch-grid count, and ω k ∈ [ π / 4 , 2 ​ π ] \omega_{k}\in[\pi/4,2\pi] the spatial frequency for rotation channel k k . While the calibrated spectrum guarantees isotropic decay at unit scale ( z = 1.0 × z=1.0\times ), compressing the coordinate mesh by zoom factor z z reduces the effective inter-patch phase difference to Δ ​ θ k = ( 2 ​ r W / ( N W ⋅ z ) ) ​ ω k \Delta\theta_{k}=(2r_{W}/(N_{W}\cdot z))\omega_{k} . This phase dampening slightly weakens relative positional discriminability between adjacent visual tokens in the spatial attention kernel ( K ⁡ ( 𝐩 i , 𝐩 i + 1 ) → 1.0 K(\mathbf{p}_{i},\mathbf{p}_{i+1})\to 1.0 , Eq. ( 6 )), resulting in geometric relaxation. While organic structures (foliage, clouds) tolerate this relaxation, man-made rigid objects (such as the linear wooden slats of the bench) exhibit noticeable curvature and structural warping.

(6))),导致几何放松. 虽然有机结构(叶片、云)能容忍这种放松,但人造刚性物体(如长椅的线性木板)显示出明显的曲率和结构扭曲。

blocks.en: In dense compositional scenes containing strong complementary colors (vibrant pink petals against neutral grey stones and brown wood), joint self-attention in the shallow encoder f θ f_{\theta} tends to disperse dominant color tokens. Under focal zoom, where coordinate density is artificially compressed, the effective receptive field of self-attention spans a broader semantic neighborhood in normalized space. This causes the pink floral pigment to bleed into adjacent latents, tinting the cobblestone path and staining the bench wood.
blocks.zh: 在含有强烈互补颜色(生动粉红色花瓣对中性灰石和棕色木材)的密集组成场景中,在浅层编码器 f θ f_{\theta }中的联合自觉往往会分散占支配地位的颜色符号. 在焦距缩放下,在坐标密度被人为压缩的地方,有效的可接受自觉领域跨越了在正常空间中更广泛的语义区. 这使得粉红色的花色 血流成相邻的潜伏物, 给鹅卵石路涂上锡, 并污渍了长凳木头。

blocks.en: D.3 Positional Representation Robustness
blocks.zh: D.3 职位代表性

blocks.en: During early exploratory pretraining on the 337K Danbooru corpus, Asuka-FM was initially optimized with discrete integer position IDs ( pos ∈ { 0 , … , N − 1 } \text{pos}\in\{0,\dots,N-1\} , where N N is the image token count). Deviating from the square aspect ratio during inference exposed an architectural failure: because inter-patch indices outside the training grid are unseen, the model interpreted the expanded canvas as additional spatial instances, replicating heads and torsos (Figure 15 (a)).
blocks.zh: 在关于337K Danbooruacle的早期探索性预训中,Asuka-FM最初被优化为离散的整数位置ID(pos {{{0,...,N − 1}\text{pos}\in\{0,\dots,N-1\}},其中N N是图像符号计数). 在推论中偏离方形侧面比例暴露了建筑故障:由于培训网格外的间隔指数是看不见的,模型将扩展的画布解释为额外的空间实例,复制头部和躯干(图15(a)).

blocks.en: (a) Discrete RoPE Collapse: Unseen integer positions outside the square grid induce harmonic repetition, causing duplicated heads and fragmented torsos along the vertical canvas.
blocks.zh: (a) 零星的ROPE碰撞: 方格网外的未见整数位置诱发口琴重复,导致头部重复,垂直帆布沿线躯干支离破碎.

In contrast, the entire 206M generative backbone forward-backward pass executes in only 888.96 ​ ms 888.96\,\text{ms} at micro-batch 16 and 1,756.68 ​ ms 1{,}756.68\,\text{ms} at micro-batch 32. Consistent with our RTX 4090 profiling at micro-batch 8 (Section 6.3 , where the frozen VAE accounts for 62.0 % 62.0\% of step latency and runs 2.42 × 2.42\times slower than the DiT backbone), the frozen autoencoder on the A40 runs nearly 3 × 3\times slower than the trainable generative backbone, causing tensor cores to idle for almost three-quarters of execution time and collapsing end-to-end system MFU to 3.66 % ​ – ​ 3.79 % 3.66\%\text{--}3.79\% . This finding reinforces that consumer-scale generative modeling cannot rely on online autoencoding at high resolutions, providing decisive systems justification for our decoupled latent-to-pixel adaptation strategy.
